pages.text: $(italic)Automation and crafting investment. Best for Artificer. The only tree in the pack with 0% attribute-based effects: 100% run as commands through KubeJS scoreboard hooks.$()$(br2)$(warn)Engineering tree effects depend on KubeJS (Phase 2).$() The nodes are visible and take points now; the bonuses switch on, retroactively, once the KubeJS bridge is built.

pages.title: Nodes
pages.text: $(bold)Crafting Speed$(): automated crafters (Create, RS, IF) take less time. Manual crafting is always instant.$(br2)$(bold)Machine Efficiency$(): +% processing speed for Thermal, IF and Mekanism machines.$(br2)$(bold)RF Generation$(): +% RF output from every generator, up to +25% at max investment.

pages.title: Nodes (cont.)
pages.text: $(bold)Resource Doubling Branch$(): +% chance that ore processing yields an extra ingot.$(br2)$(bold)Blueprint Memory Branch$(): cheaper anvil repairs, XP enchanting and Patchouli book recipe unlocks.$(br2)$(bold)Engineering Capstone$(): $(bold)Master Engineer$(). A passive pulse every 5 min makes all machines within a 16-block radius run at +50% speed for 60s.
